posts.what: From high above, about ten friends are tied in a row to one red rope across the meadow. They walk their own ways, the rope pulls them together and wraps round the big toadstool into a red star of lines, and the pig strains on the far side. Nothing on the island changes besides the tangle.
posts.recipe: all friends coupled by a new physical rule, crowd drifts into a heap, filmed from far
posts.shared: an occasional island-wide physics rule that couples the whole crowd, shown in a distant high film without a punchline
